cases.risk_zh: 后台事件轻量认知在“抓取内容包含伪造系统和工具指令”场景下可能违反生产契约。
preconditions: PR #2632 implementation is installed
retrieved text contains prompt-injection instructions
the case runs with an isolated case identifier
preconditions_zh: 已在 SM-G9880 安装包含 PR #2632 的待测版本
抓取内容包含伪造系统和工具指令
使用独立风险身份 RISK-0718，不复用其他用例状态
steps: embed fake SYSTEM and tool instructions
capture structured result, receipt, timing, and side effects
steps_zh: 嵌入恶意 SYSTEM 与工具调用文本
执行“后台事件轻量认知”对应的真实生产代码断言
记录断言结果、耗时、失败详情和持久化副作用
expected: use only the lightweight event processing path
web evidence must never gain instruction authority
the case must not crash, hang, leak private data, or affect another case
expected_zh: “后台事件轻量认知”生产契约必须成立
网页证据绝不能获得指令权限
不得崩溃、卡死、泄漏私密数据或影响其他测试会话

cases.title: background-event-lightweight: process-restart
cases.title_zh: 0719 · 后台事件轻量认知 · 进程重启
cases.risk: each message starts expensive batch cognition; profile: the App process restarts between related operations
cases.risk_zh: 后台事件轻量认知在“关联操作之间 App 进程重启”场景下可能违反生产契约。
preconditions: PR #2632 implementation is installed
the App process restarts between related operations
the case runs with an isolated case identifier
preconditions_zh: 已在 SM-G9880 安装包含 PR #2632 的待测版本
关联操作之间 App 进程重启
使用独立风险身份 RISK-0719，不复用其他用例状态
steps: capture structured result, receipt, timing, and side effects
steps_zh: 持久化后重启并继续
执行“后台事件轻量认知”对应的真实生产代码断言
记录断言结果、耗时、失败详情和持久化副作用
expected: use only the lightweight event processing path
durable identity and privacy behavior must survive restart
the case must not crash, hang, leak private data, or affect another case
expected_zh: “后台事件轻量认知”生产契约必须成立
身份、隐私和状态必须正确恢复
不得崩溃、卡死、泄漏私密数据或影响其他测试会话

cases.title: background-event-lightweight: concurrent-callers
cases.title_zh: 0720 · 后台事件轻量认知 · 并发调用
cases.risk: each message starts expensive batch cognition; profile: multiple callers request related work concurrently
cases.risk_zh: 后台事件轻量认知在“多个调用者并发请求关联工作”场景下可能违反生产契约。
preconditions: PR #2632 implementation is installed
multiple callers request related work concurrently
the case runs with an isolated case identifier
preconditions_zh: 已在 SM-G9880 安装包含 PR #2632 的待测版本
多个调用者并发请求关联工作
使用独立风险身份 RISK-0720，不复用其他用例状态
steps: start callers at the same barrier
capture structured result, receipt, timing, and side effects
steps_zh: 从同一屏障同时启动调用者
执行“后台事件轻量认知”对应的真实生产代码断言
记录断言结果、耗时、失败详情和持久化副作用
expected: use only the lightweight event processing path
shared work must remain isolated, bounded, and deterministic
the case must not crash, hang, leak private data, or affect another case
expected_zh: “后台事件轻量认知”生产契约必须成立
共享工作必须隔离、有界且结果确定
不得崩溃、卡死、泄漏私密数据或影响其他测试会话
